market.note: Best available price per outcome from the oddschecker PL coupon (fetched in the built-in browser 2026-11-23) for 9 of 10 MW12 fixtures. Arsenal v Man City (Sun 29 Nov 16:30) did not appear on the oddschecker coupon; its 1X2 (6/5, 5/2, 2/1) is wincomparator's listed single-book line for 29-Nov-2026 (overround ~7.4%), recorded with a distinct source so the mixed origin is auditable. midweek_matches.source: UEFA league-phase MD5 fixtures 24-26 Nov 2026 involving PL clubs, from Wikipedia 2026-27 UCL/UEL/UECL league-phase pages (fetched 2026-11-23). UCL MD5 24-25 Nov; UEL MD5 26 Nov; Brighton's UECL game (v Univ. Craiova) is 26 Nov. EFL Cup QF is week of 14 Dec (outside the window). Arsenal (24 Nov) and Aston Villa (away, 24 Nov) dates are summary-sourced and slightly less certain than the other rows; both are recorded as 24 Nov. International/PL-to-PL matches are not cup/European and are not listed, per the v2 basis definition.
